slugs.title: Facebook slugs or URLs
slugs.description: One vanity slug or profile URL per line. 'nike', 'facebook.com/nike' and 'https://www.facebook.com/nike/' are all accepted and reduce to the same slug.

pages.title: Slugs with an expected brand
pages.description: Use this instead of 'slugs' when you know which brand each slug is supposed to belong to. Each entry is {"slug": "nike", "expectedBrand": "Nike"}. Only entries given here are brand-checked; the others are existence-checked only.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Facebook page URLs, for pasting a list straight out of another actor's dataset.

onlyExisting.title: Only pages that exist
onlyExisting.description: Drop every slug that does not resolve to a page.
onlyExisting.groupDescription: Applied after checking, so the run summary still counts everything.

onlyNotFound.title: Only slugs that do not exist
onlyNotFound.description: Keep only the dead slugs - the list-cleaning view. Cannot be combined with 'Only pages that exist'.

onlyBrandMismatch.title: Only brand mismatches
onlyBrandMismatch.description: Keep only slugs whose page belongs to a different brand than expected, or matches it only weakly. Needs 'pages' with an expectedBrand.

minFollowers.title: Minimum followers
minFollowers.description: Drop pages below this follower count. Pages whose follower count could not be read are dropped too, since an unknown count cannot be shown to clear the bar.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many slugs to fetch at once. Facebook pages are large (up to ~20 MB each), so raising this speeds the run up but costs memory.

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: Append one RUN_SUMMARY record with the totals: how many exist, how many are dead, how many brand mismatches.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the results to the key-value store in these formats. The dataset is always produced regardless.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. This surface applies no TLS or IP gate, so the default direct connection works and a proxy only adds latency and cost. Enable it only if your own network is restricted.
